# Vesper palette attribution

Default UI colors are adapted from [vladzima/vesper-theme](https://github.com/vladzima/vesper-theme), VSCode/Vesper.json, based on Rauno Freiberg's Vesper. The reference repository is distributed under Apache-2.0; its license is retained in vesper-theme-LICENSE.txt. This application does not bundle the editor theme itself or Donut source code.
